comments.body: Curious whether comments on old versions belong in this drawer or stay out of v1—leaning out.

content.text: Curious whether comments on old versions belong in this drawer or stay out of v1—leaning out.
Version history currently navigates authors away from the editing surface into a separate history route, breaking flow during reviews.

Add a changelog drawer anchored to the editor chrome listing versions with actor, timestamp, and optional message. Selecting a version shows a read-only preview beside the live doc; restore remains a two-click confirm. Drawer can stay open while the user continues editing the live version.
Success metrics: opening history no longer unmounts the editor session, keyboard Esc closes the drawer, and large docs (500+ versions) virtualize the list.
